assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted overall boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry derived from the repository site package.
assumptions.impact: All area values and map relationships are comparative design evidence only and must be recalculated when official geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: Land-use bands, building renewal actions, roads, public spaces, and phases are conceptual design layers generated inside the provisional boundary.
assumptions.impact: They express spatial intent and scenario relationships; they do not establish land ownership, approved zoning, demolition, construction scale, or road redlines.

assumptions.statement: Authoritative building inventory, ownership, heritage controls, road and rail engineering, municipal capacity, energy, and fire-safety data are not available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: FAR, heights, retain-renovate-demolish quantities, facility capacity, and engineering feasibility remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios use data minimization, human review, manual takeover, offline alternatives, and visible pause or exit conditions as design requirements.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards are reference prototypes for professional and operational deepening, not approved deployments or supplier commitments.

assumptions.statement: Comparative cases, cultural materials, typefaces, images, logos, and public display assets require source, license, and attribution review before redistribution.
assumptions.impact: The package uses original diagrams and text; third-party marks and historical images are not embedded as formal evidence.
